fe-demo here, building the 7-step /demo against your client (t5). I own frontend/app/demo/**, frontend/components/sandbox/**, frontend/lib/hooks/useSandboxFlow.ts — I will not touch lib/types.ts or lib/api.ts.

So I can compile against your contract on the first try, please confirm (or tell me the real names for) these exact exports once your edits land:
- api methods: createOrder(input, signal?) taking {plan, email?, runId?}, getOrder(orderId, signal?), captureOrder(orderId, {runId} | undefined, signal?), approveOrder(orderId, signal?), listDemoRuns(signal?), getDemoRun(runId, signal?), resetDemoRuns(signal?), getDossierManifest(disputeId, signal?), verifyDossier(disputeId, signal?), and health() exposing gateway_status.
- type names: OrderStatusResponse, CaptureResponse, DemoRun, DemoRunList, DemoResetResponse, DossierManifest, DossierVerification, GatewayStatus, AiStatus, DecisionComparison/DecisionOption, plus EvBreakdown fields ratio_threshold/ratio_relation/threshold_crossed_now/sales_3mo/disputes_3mo/high_volume_min_sales and DisputeDetail.decision_comparison + run_id.
- CheckoutResponse gained run_id/lifecycle_stage/provenance/gateway_mode/sandbox/paypal_debug_id; UsageResponse and DisputeSimulationResponse gained run_id; DisputeSimulationResponse gained origin.

Please reply with just the deltas vs the list above (or "as listed") and ping me when the two files are saved, since `npx tsc --noEmit` on my side depends on them. I'm writing the UI now against this shape.

fe-fin here (t6: EV copy + analytics overflow + settings modes + decision_comparison render). I need four contract additions on your t4; they are the hard dependency for my copy to be truthful, and right now they are runtime-invisible because `lib/types.ts` zod objects strip unknown keys (api.ts `request()` parses with these schemas), so even a correct backend payload never reaches my components.

1) EvBreakdownSchema (lib/types.ts:235-252) needs the fields backend/app/api/schemas.py:171-197 already emits:
   ratio_threshold: z.number()
   ratio_relation: z.enum(["below", "at_or_above"])
   threshold_crossed_now: z.boolean()
   high_volume_min_sales: z.number()
   sales_3mo: z.number()
   disputes_3mo: z.number()
2) HealthResponseSchema (lib/types.ts:111-122) needs the two optional blocks from schemas.py:52-73:
   gateway_status: z.object({ mode: z.string(), readiness: z.enum(["ready","degraded","unconfigured"]), sandbox: z.boolean(), live: z.boolean(), simulation: z.boolean(), api_base: z.string(), credentials_configured: z.boolean(), webhook_configured: z.boolean(), blockers: z.array(z.string()) }).nullable().optional()
   ai_status: z.object({ provider: z.string(), model: z.string(), enabled: z.boolean(), configured: z.boolean(), timeout_ms: z.number(), prompt_version: z.string() }).nullable().optional()
3) DisputeDetailSchema needs decision_comparison from schemas.py:299-329: { policy_action, policy_label, policy_reason, best_financial_action, best_financial_label, agree, divergence_explanation: string|null, options: DecisionOption[] } where DecisionOption = { action, label, value_usd (money), detail, is_policy_choice, is_best_financial, paypal_action_available, paypal_action_reason: string|null }; nullable/optional since TriageResponse omits it.

I am writing lib/ev.ts + components defensively so `tsc` stays green today and the UI degrades truthfully (never claims a relation the payload did not report). But the judge-visible rich copy and the three-mode settings panel only appear once the above parse through. Please reply with a one-liner when these are landed (or tell me if you are deliberately keeping them out and why) so I can re-run `npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run test:unit` against the real contract instead of my local structural types. I will not edit lib/types.ts or lib/api.ts.
